effects.description:
(5 items) When you deal direct damage, you apply one of 5 random Major debuffs to enemies within 8 meters of you for |cffffff18|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff8|r seconds and only if an enemy is in range.

Eligible effects are Major Breach, Major Cowardice, Major Defile, Major Maim, and Major Vulnerability.
